parallel.requirements: The parent recognized the need for ESM .mjs files, manual argparse-compatible CLI behavior, exact unit_len/cardinalize output, and /output delivery.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: It created task records for probing, CLI mapping, implementation, and verification, then launched a broad workflow of probe children while retaining parent ownership of implementation.
parallel.implementation: After extensive probing it wrote only pystring.mjs, argparse.mjs, and sysio.mjs under /output/lib; no inflection layer, public facade, unitlen module, or test12.mjs was delivered.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Artifact validation copied only three support libraries and explicitly expected test12.mjs, so the output tree was not assembled into an executable entrypoint.
parallel.verification: The parent planned differential fuzzing but never reached integrated verification of a runnable Node entry; official evaluation therefore found no passing samples.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run timed out with the workflow still consuming budget and the required entrypoint absent, producing 0/170 despite substantial behavioral research.

serial.requirements: Serial recognized the same ESM, manual CLI, no-dependency, black-box behavior, library hierarchy, and /output entrypoint requirements.
serial.plan_and_ownership: It kept the whole task in a single local trajectory: inspect source, probe executable, write modules, write entrypoint, test, and report.
serial.implementation: It implemented irregular plural tables, Python string helpers, case matching, inflection, unit length, argparse, a facade, and the test12.mjs entrypoint.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The copied artifact contained test12.mjs and all supporting library files, satisfying artifact validation for the expected entry.
serial.verification: It ran a 959-case differential harness, direct CLI checks, and a 1200-case fuzz pass before final response.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The official evaluator still marked solution_passed false at 169/170, indicating one remaining edge mismatch rather than a delivery failure.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the Node ESM, manual CLI parsing, /output placement, and black-box behavioral matching requirements.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial worked from the same prompt requirements and Python wrapper, including the .mjs entry and library split constraints.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Requirement recognition was broadly similar; the difference was delivery, not an initial misunderstanding of the prompt.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split the work into probe tasks, implementation, verification, and a separate exhaustive workflow with many child agents.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all probing, implementation, and verification in one trajectory with delegation tools disabled.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel dispersed the investigation into a broad worker fleet; serial retained direct ownership of the whole migration path.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child briefs were detailed but scoped to black-box probing and TSV/finding production rather than implementation interfaces.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial directly designed the module interface and entry imports while implementing the library hierarchy.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No context omission is proved; the material contrast is that parallel context moved probe data around, while serial used its findings immediately in module contracts.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel began implementation late and wrote pystring, argparse, and sysio support files only.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote irregulars, pystr, casematch, inflection, unitlen, strutils, argparse, and test12.mjs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel never produced the entrypoint or full inflection/module stack; serial did.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched the workflow in the background and many child trajectories remained interrupted or in-flight as the run closed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child-result lifecycle and closed after local testing and final reporting.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a large child-result lifecycle that never resolved into the required artifact; serial had no join or child-return risk.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used a shared /tmp/probe harness and generated many probe files, but only partial /output support libraries were copied.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial assembled the complete /output file tree including the expected entry and all support modules.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The shared probe state did not become a complete deliverable in parallel; serial integrated the code tree into the artifact.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel created a verification task but never reached integrated differential verification for a complete entrypoint.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran a 959-case differential harness, additional CLI checks, and a 1200-case fuzz pass before final response.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel verification was displaced by unfinished assembly; serial verified a real runnable implementation.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used 34 subagents, 683 workflow-child tool calls, and ran until the 2399 second timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial finished in 1543 seconds with 855 seconds of the cell budget remaining.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel exhausted its closure budget before assembly; serial completed implementation and checks well before the limit.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official pass/fail relation is both_fail because both status.json evaluation records set solution_passed to false. The practical task-solving quality is nevertheless very different: parallel timed out and delivered no expected test12.mjs entry, giving 0/170; serial delivered a complete artifact with entrypoint and modules, verified it extensively, and reached 169/170.
parallel_contributors: Broad probe workflow fan-out consumed the finite run budget before final assembly.
Implementation began late and stopped after partial support libraries, leaving the required entrypoint missing.
No integrated verification of a runnable Node entry occurred before closure.
serial_contributors: Serial maintained direct ownership of probing, implementation, and verification.
Serial wrote the full module tree and test12.mjs entrypoint before running differential tests.
Serial completed with remaining budget and artifact validation succeeded.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial still missed one official testcase, so its boolean solution_passed field remained false despite high coverage.
Parallel did not reach a comparable ordinary implementation-defect stage because the artifact was structurally incomplete.
evaluator_effects: The official relation is both_fail rather than serial_only_pass because the evaluator requires solution_passed true, not merely a high pass rate.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: Supported comparative contributors for artifact and score quality; not an exclusive root cause and not a pass/fail outcome differential.

Rejected: the missing entry file is real, but the parent owned /output assembly and had an implementation task; missing completion is not missing ownership.
Rejected: the parent created implementation and verification tasks and was the pipeline owner; the pipeline failed because budget was spent on probing fan-out.
Rejected: productive work was not blocked behind one mandatory serial preflight; the parent and children probed in parallel and the later failure came from excessive breadth.
Rejected: investigation did not complete as a clean first phase before implementation; the parent probed and wrote while workflow work was still active, making fan-out exhaustion more specific.
Rejected as the nearest suppressed label: the implementation path lacked time, but this is better captured by the retained broad fan-out budget exhaustion episode.

The parent launched an intentionally exhaustive workflow with twelve sweep agents, then a critic and gapfill phase, while continuing extensive local probing. The run consumed the full cell budget and ended with only three support libraries copied and no expected test12.mjs entry. The serial run kept ownership local, wrote the entry plus libraries, and verified them before closure.
candidates.realized_consequence: The parallel artifact was left without test12.mjs and scored 0/170 after timeout, while the serial artifact contained the entrypoint and reached 169/170.
candidates.near_match_reason: Implementation work was starved, but the direct allocation boundary was the collectively broad fan-out and gapfill workflow exhausting the finite budget, not generic underallocation alone.
